Name: Seasonal Younger Wizard - Moth's Vanilla Facelift-style Portraits
Author: mothbeanie
Description:
A retexture of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9723]BBR's Seasonal Younger Wizard[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106000973]BBR[/url] to match the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116]Vanilla Facelift[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/67968777]siamece[/url]. Also includes sprites, and versions for SVE and Romanceable Rasmodius!

For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]. You do not need to also have BBR's Seasonal Younger Wizard installed when using this.


[u]Config:[/u]

[b]WizardHat: [/b][i]true [/i]for hat, [i]false [/i]for no hat (default: [i]true[/i])
